summary: Full pre-Sudoku regression sweep across YouBelong backend + mobile frontend smoke. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_regression_sweep.py (37 pytest cases) covering signup-with-birthday, login lockout (5-strike → 429), forgot-password full reset round-trip (mocked dev_code in JSON until email provider wired), 4 demo logins, profile edit persistence, friends lifecycle (send/accept/decline/cancel/duplicate-400), flutter copy sweep ('is looking to chat' + 'would like to chat 🦋'), notice CRUD with author-only edit/delete, block/report, coffee-lounge HTTP join+leave AND WebSocket auto-status side-effect (status→in_coffee_lounge on WS connect, restored on disconnect), memory-match catalog/daily smoke, /games/dailies aggregator audit, server-source wording grep. Result: 35/37 PASSED. The 2 failures are REAL PRODUCT BUGS (block-filter on Find Friends + memory missing from /games/dailies). Pre-existing suite: 135/138 pass (3 stale-test failures, NOT product bugs — see context_for_next_testing_agent). Frontend smoke (Expo web @ 390x844): landing → /auth/login → 'Try a demo' → Frankie demo-login → home all render cleanly; bell badge '9+'; Community Highlights cards visible. Wording sweep CLEAN — no 'looking for company / wants to chat / dating / lonely / partner / single seniors' in either server.py or frontend (the one 'dating app' mention in settings.tsx is the intentional 'NOT a dating app' policy line). React Native deprecation warnings detected in console: shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents.

critical.issue: Blocked users still appear in Find Friends — endpoint accepts NO viewer_id query param and does not filter against the caller's user.blocked array (server.py:490-503). After POST /users/{viewer}/block/{baddie} the viewer's user doc DOES gain baddie in 'blocked', but GET /users still returns baddie. The review request explicitly says: 'blocked user disappears from Find Friends'.

minor.issue: Aggregator returns only {date, jigsaw, trivia, wordsearch} — memory match is missing despite having its own /api/games/memory/daily endpoint. Home 'Community Today / Highlights' won't surface the memory daily. server.py:1160-1175.

Returns 11 demos but only 8 are official per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Three orphan demos in Mongo: 'bob the bioder' (username contains a SPACE — would normally fail signup validation), 'gazza' (Garry), 'billbob' (Billy). They appear on the 'Try a demo' picker and clutter the UI. Either delete the orphans from Mongo or constrain the endpoint to the canonical whitelist.

No server-side password length enforcement — the frontend asks for ≥6 chars but the API accepts any length (test_signup_short_password_accepted_but_login_rejected returned 422 from Pydantic only because of body shape; pure short pwd '123' is accepted). Mirror the ≥6 rule on the server.

Crashes with 500 (KeyError) when caller uses 'from_user_id'/'to_user_id' instead of 'from_id'/'to_id'. The body schema is an untyped dict and there is no Pydantic validation, so a malformed call returns 500 not 400. server.py:2757-2778. Replace `body: dict` with a Pydantic FlutterSendBody for safe input validation.

Legacy endpoint persists reports with shape {from, target, reason} — different from the modern /api/reports schema ({reporter_id, target_user_id, target_type, status, ...}). /api/admin/reports only surfaces docs in the new shape, so legacy reports are invisible to admins. Either route legacy POST through the new submit_report code path, or migrate/delete the old endpoint.

passlib + bcrypt 4.x version-probe warning at startup (AttributeError: module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'). Functionally harmless, but pollutes logs. Pin passlib 1.7.5+ or bcrypt 4.0.x compatible.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 11 demo cards instead of the documented 8. 'Bob the bioder' card has a space-containing @username which looks broken and is a typo of 'broder/builder'. Hide non-canonical demos or whitelist on the client.

integration_issues.issue: POST /users/{me}/block/{x} succeeds but GET /api/users still returns x (no viewer_id param). The user/[id] action menu's Block button leaves the user visible in Find Friends — spec violation.
/api/games/dailies has no 'memory' key, so home highlights can't surface today's memory match (other dailies — wordsearch / trivia / jigsaw — do show).

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props → use boxShadow; 'textShadow*' → use textShadow; 'props.pointerEvents' → use style.pointerEvents. Migrate styles in StyleSheet.create calls to silence and to be RN ≥ 0.75 ready.

react_native_issues.issue: shadow* and textShadow* style props are deprecated in React Native Web — use boxShadow / textShadow instead. Reference: console warnings on every screen load.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated — move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: console warning after tapping 'Try a demo account' on /auth/login.

action_items: [CRITICAL] Add viewer_id query param to GET /api/users and exclude users in viewer.blocked AND users whose blocked array contains viewer_id. Block must be bidirectionally invisible. server.py:490.
[MEDIUM] Add 'memory' entry to /api/games/dailies (server.py:1160) so home Community Highlights includes memory match daily like the other 3 games.

[MEDIUM] Clean orphan demo users from Mongo (bob the bioder / gazza / billbob) OR whitelist /api/auth/demo-accounts to the canonical 8 from test_credentials.md. Also reject usernames containing whitespace at signup.
[LOW] Replace `body: dict` on POST /api/flutters/send with a Pydantic FlutterSendBody — current shape returns 500 on missing keys instead of 400.
[LOW] Either remove or rewrite the legacy POST /api/users/{uid}/report/{other_id} endpoint — it writes reports in an old schema invisible to /api/admin/reports.
[LOW] Enforce password ≥6 chars in /api/auth/signup body schema (currently only frontend-enforced).
[LOW] Migrate React Native style props (shadow* → boxShadow, textShadow* → textShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) across all screens to remove console deprecation warnings.
[LOW] Pin passlib/bcrypt to a compatible pair to remove the bcrypt __about__ warning at backend startup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:490 list_users() — no viewer-aware filter. Needs viewer_id query + Mongo filter `{ 'id': { '$nin': viewer.blocked }, 'blocked': { '$ne': viewer_id } }`.
server.py:1160 dailies() — missing memory entry; suggested: 'memory': {'available': True, 'title': f'Daily Memory Match · {theme_label}'} mirroring the wordsearch shape.
server.py:2757 send_flutter() — body: dict + body['from_id'] indexing → 500 on bad input. Add a Pydantic model with from_id/to_id required, message optional.
server.py:520 report_user() — legacy schema {from, target, reason} won't surface in /admin/reports. Either funnel through submit_report() or remove.

server.py:304 signup() — username≥3 enforced; password length not enforced; usernames with whitespace currently NOT rejected at signup (the orphan demos in Mongo prove this via direct insert, but signup also lacks the check).

success_rate.backend: 94.6% (35/37 in new suite; 170/175 across all suites — 5 failures, of which 2 are real bugs and 3 are stale-test artifacts)
success_rate.frontend: smoke-tested only — landing, auth/login, demo-login, home all render and navigate; no red screen, no broken assets

seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_iter10_ in users/notifications/friend_requests/notices/reports. Module-level autouse fixture purges before and after the test module — Mongo will be clean after the run. The lockout test creates and locks 'TEST_iter10_lockme' for 15 min; harmless because the fixture deletes it on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pre-existing legacy failures (NOT product bugs, do not refile): (1) test_phase_a_regression.py::test_preferences_endpoint_existence expects 404 but the endpoint now returns 200 — the test is stale, server now persists prefs via PATCH /users/{uid}/preferences; (2) test_youbelong_api.py::test_login_maggie expects badge 'Friendly Butterfly' but maggie's seeded badges are now {Friendly Member, Social Star, Helpful Neighbour, Community Builder} — badge was renamed; (3) test_youbelong_api.py::test_friend_request returns 400 because frankie+maggie are already friends from prior accept tests — test data leakage in legacy file. None of these reflect regressions in shipped behavior; the new iter10 suite uses fresh TEST_iter10_ accounts to avoid the same pitfall. Mongo orphan demos to clean (or whitelist on the endpoint): 'bob the bioder', 'gazza', 'billbob'.
rca_of_issue: BUG-1 (HIGH, block not enforced in Find Friends): server.py:490 list_users() signature is (suburb, interest, q) — no viewer_id. The user/[id] action menu fires POST /users/{me}/block/{x} which correctly $addToSet's x into user.blocked, but Find Friends never reads that array. Repro: demo-login as Frankie → user/[other] → Block → return to Find Friends → other still listed. Fix: add `viewer_id: Optional[str] = None` query param, read viewer.blocked + blockers (users whose blocked contains viewer_id), append `{ 'id': { '$nin': viewer.blocked }, 'blocked': { '$ne': viewer_id } }` to the Mongo query. BUG-2 (MEDIUM, memory missing from dailies): server.py:1160 dailies() literally only assembles 3 game keys; memory_match.py exposes a /games/memory/daily and a daily_pick() but is not called from dailies(). Fix: import memory daily helper and add a 'memory' branch like the wordsearch branch.
